title: 🏆 We Are Young [V5]
description: Listed on an early Watch The Throne tracklist given out by music insider blog The DOTR. According to Jeff Bhasker. "They were going to rap over the beat, but everything gets changed at the last minute. I was working with them on Watch The Throne when I met Nate [Ruess] and I said, ‘Maybe you guys want to mess with this’ and [Ruess] really liked it a lot". According to Ken Lewis, he created the snare on the song, likely during Watch The Throne sessions. MIKE DEAN mentioned wanting to use the hook, with Hogan saying that THE-DREAM and Nate Reuss were on it. Jack Antonoff confirmed that Kanye and JAŸ-Z did record for it and he even said some lyrics. Also according to Hogan, part of Kanye's verse was reused for "Primetime". There's a recreation in the Fakes tab showing what Kanye's part might've sounded like.

title: YEEZY 500 HIGH
description: The adidas Yeezy 500 High ‘Frosted Blue’ showcases a contrasting two-tone color palette on a retro-inspired lifestyle sneaker that traces a lineage to the adidas KB8 III. The upper is composed of stretchy elastane in a vibrant blue finish, fortified with suede overlays in a lighter blue shade. They’re joined by tan suede on the sneaker’s segmented eyestay and reinforced toe wrap. Additional details include toggle lacing and a padded, high-cut collar. Cushioning arrives via a podular adiPRENE midsole that gives the nod to adidas’ Feet You Wear technology.

title: JC-05
description:
Background: Designed by Doug/@donebydoug on Instagram, with model images shot by Andre Troutman and modeled by Marwang Lual.

The JC-05 is based on Ye's altered Balenciaga Sporty B Taxi Blouson. Ye had worn prototypes of the JC-05 multiple times in 2024, out in Los Angeles and during his Vultures LP's.

Yeezy began shipping JC-05 orders in October 2025 and would release the JC-05 in person at a Mexico pop-up on 02/07/2026 for $150.

Documented wear by Ye:
• 06/25/2025 in an Instagram story at his LA Mansion
• 07/06/2025 with Hassan and Jesse Lee Peterson

title: TS-07 (CALIFORNIA)
description:
Background: Designed by Mark Seekings with a graphic either designed or referenced from Gosha Rubchinsky, the TS-07 California was initially released at a Los Angeles pop-up event for Ye’s Los Angeles concerts at SoFi Stadium.

Happybelly Vending hosted sales outside SoFi Stadium for days leading up to and including Ye’s Los Angeles concerts.

The TS-07 features an updated logo compared to the Mexico release, with a Chinese flag replacing the Mexico flag, "YE LIVE IN CALIFORNIA" printed beneath it, and "LOS ANGELES 04 01/03 26" printed on the back of the neck.

Release Date: 03/27/2026
